name: Tranco Top Sites Ranking API
summary: Free API for a research-grade ranking of the most popular domains, with 30-day rank history per domain and list downloads.
description: Tranco combines the Cisco Umbrella, Majestic, Radar and Chrome UX Report (CrUX) top-site lists (the providers listed in the list configuration at check: crux, farsight, majestic, radar, umbrella) into one manipulation-resistant ranking, updated daily. The API returns the rank history of a domain over at least the past 30 daily lists and metadata plus a download URL for any daily or custom list (top 1 million). It is the usual replacement for the retired Alexa ranking.

auth.notes: The rank and list-metadata endpoints need nothing; only /lists/create (custom lists) requires an account.

rate_limit.summary: 1 query per second on the rank endpoint (documented); exceeding it returns 429. Requests sent in quick succession during checking did get 429.

endpoints.summary: Daily rank of a domain over the past 30 or more days
Metadata and download URL of the daily list (date as YYYYmmdd or latest)
Metadata of a list by id

license.name: Not stated for the combined list; the component lists carry CC BY 3.0, CC BY-SA 4.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0 licences

coverage.temporal: Daily lists, each combining the previous 30 days

agent_notes: Rank 1 is most popular. An unlisted domain returns 200 with an empty ranks array, not 404. Use the registrable (pay-level) domain; www.google.com also answered 200 but the default lists exclude subdomains. For bulk work download the list through lists/date/latest (the download field gives the file URL; the CSV layout was not inspected) instead of querying per domain. Space requests at least one second apart.
caveats: Provider terms for the combined list were not found; check the site and cite the Tranco paper (linked from the homepage) when you use it in research.
The /lists/date docs say YYYYmmdd; a dashed date (2026-11-01) also answered 200.
403 'service temporarily unavailable' is documented for the rank endpoint.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without credentials; /lists/date/latest returned list id and download URL; repeat calls within a second returned 429.
